| **task** | A benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on sequential financial decision-making (Buy/Sell/Hold) across stocks, cryptocurrencies and ETFs. | “we introduce InvestorBench, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating LLM-based agents in diverse financial decision-making contexts.” |
| **architecture** | FinMem-based agent with Brain (LLM backbone), Perception, Profile, Memory (working memory with immediate/extended reflection plus layered long-term vector-store memory with decay), and Action modules; warm-up stage builds memory, then evaluation. | “InvestorBench includes an advanced LLM-based agent equipped with modules for Brain, Perception, Profile, Memory, and Action. | **data** | Daily data. Stocks: Yahoo Finance OHLCV, SEC 10-Q/10-K, news for MSFT, JNJ, UVV, HON, TSLA, AAPL, NIO. Crypto: CoinMarketCap OHLCV and crypto news for BTC, ETH.
